segments.exact: Grafting moves from late March, as the 1 October call set it, to the second half of February. The rootstock is still dormant in February, and last year's February trial row took at twice the rate of the March grafts.

circumstance.context: Memo announcing a change to the orchard grafting schedule, with its rationale

segments.note: One move: announcing the schedule change together with its supporting rationale; kept as one segment per the torn-rule.
